source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the reactivity of Group 2 (PDF 5-6).

blocks.text: Group 2 anasir ki reactivity un ki electronic configuration se samajh aati hai. Yeh apne do bairooni electrons (ns2) kho kar mustahkam M2+ ions banate hain, jis se aasani se react karte hain. Reactivity beryllium se barium tak barhti hai kyunke atoms bare hote, shielding barhti aur ionization energy ghat'ti hai, is liye electrons aasani se nikalte hain.

blocks.alt: Group 2 ke paanch anasir (elements) Be, Mg, Ca, Sr aur Ba: har aik laal aadhe gole (atom) ki shakal mein, jis ke neeche chhota neela aadha gola (us ka M2+ ion) hai. Beryllium se barium tak dono barhte jate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.1: Group 2 anasir ke atoms ke nisbati size (kitab ki Figure 17.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Baen se daen: beryllium, magnesium, calcium, strontium aur barium. Har laal aadha gola pichhle se bara hai, aur us ke neeche ka neela aadha gola bhi.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Laal hissa atom hai aur neela hissa us ka M2+ ion. Ion atom se kaafi chhota hai kyunke do bairooni electrons nikalne se poora khol (shell) chala jata hai. Table 17.1 ki qeematein: atom Be 112, Mg 160, Ca 197, Sr 215, Ba 222 pm; ion 31, 65, 99, 113, 135 pm. Size barhne se bairooni electrons aasani se nikalte hain, is liye reactivity Be se Ba tak barhti hai.

blocks.title: Group 2 ka reactivity series
blocks.text: Be < Mg < Ca < Sr < Ba: beryllium sab se kam aur barium sab se zyada reactive unsar hai.

blocks.prompt: Mg, Ba aur Ca ko barhti reactivity ki tarteeb mein likhein.
blocks.explanation: Mg < Ca < Ba, group mein un ki jagah ke mutabiq.

items: Group 2 dhaatein do electrons kho kar M2+ ions banati hain.
Reactivity group mein neeche barhti: Be < Mg < Ca < Sr < Ba.
